messages:
Alice M.: FYI acct `ACME-42` raised a ticket — invoice shows ~900 reserved GPU hours for Feb but metrics show token burn ~10k. billing asked for repro steps. Can anyone confirm what might create 'shadow' hour drains?
Bob L.: Noticed similar yesterday on a different account, looked like warmup probes from healthcheck service.
Chandra R.: @Bob L. which probe? we have the prewarm probe path `/internal/prewarm` and the failover snat-checker. Those should be excluded from commit metering though.
Bob L.: Right. The odd thing: the kube prober sends a POST with header `X-Redwood-Probe: 1` but some legacy routing strips headers and it ends up as a normal request to the dedicated pool. Might get billed as reserved hours if it pins a GPU.
Alice M.: Support ticket includes request id `req_0ac3b1f` and a sample trace id. I pulled the request details:
```
method: POST
path: /internal/prewarm
headers: {
  Host: dedicated-eu1.redwood.example
  Authorization: Bearer redacted
  X-Redwood-Probe: 1
}
body: {"probe":true}
```
It shows model variant `redwood-13b-q4` was started and a warmup sequence of ~2048 tokens then closed.
Jamie (sre): If the runtime instantiates a model and GPU allocation happens, we meter reserved hours based on instance uptime, not token count. Even a single prewarm can cause the instance to be marked as used for metering windows.
Jan (billing): We saw a cluster of ~260 prewarm allocations on 2026-02-12 03:00-05:00 UTC for ACME-42 — each allocation shows ~2.5h in the reserve ledger. That matches the invoice line items.
Chandra R.: That's odd, our prewarm config normally sets `max_prewarm_time=30s`. Need to check retries + failure path. If probes are failing and being retried with backoff, the controller may spin up longer lived instances.
Bob L.: I found controller logs for that window: `controller: failed probe, scheduling prewarm; probe retry loop count=12; backoff=15s` — so multiple retries could extend instance lifetime.
Alice M.: Support asked for repro steps and what header conditions cause a probe to be treated as billable. Any concrete steps we can hand off?
Jamie (sre): Repro idea: use a dedicated pool with `X-Redwood-Probe` stripped (simulate strip by routing through our old edge) and send failing probe responses so controller keeps retrying. Steps: 1) set up a tiny dedicated pool 2) route prewarm through legacy edge (header strip) 3) send POSTs with body `{"probe":true}` but make runtime return 500 for first 10 attempts. That should create repeated prewarm allocations.
Chandra R.: Add this curl script for repro (send to staging dedicated pool):
```
for i in $(seq 1 12); do
  curl -i -X POST https://staging-dedicated.redwood.example/internal/prewarm \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer ${TOKEN}" \
    -d '{"probe":true}' || true
  sleep 15
done
```
That will simulate retry/backoff.
Jan (billing): If you can reproduce on staging and capture the metering ledger export (S3 path) that shows `allocation_start/allocation_end` rows we can map ledger -> invoice. Please include request_id and pool_id.
Alice M.: Will run the repro on a sandbox pool and attach ledger export. Also will confirm whether the controller sets `metering_exempt=true` when `X-Redwood-Probe` present and honored.
Bob L.: Quick note: older edge (v1) does strip unknown headers; new edge (v2) preserves `X-Redwood-Probe`. So accounts behind older edge may be affected.
Jamie (sre): Ops action items: 1) add guard to controller to mark allocations metering_exempt if origin IP in known probe list OR `probe` body true; 2) billing to backfill credits for ACME-42 while fix is rolled.
Jan (billing): I'll provision provisional credit for ACME-42 for the disputed 900h while engineering confirms root cause. Need support ticket id and ledger rows.
Alice M.: Ticket updated: attaching ledger slice and stack traces after running repro on staging.
support-bot: Automation: created incident INC-2026-0023 to track this; assigned to `eng-runtime` and `billing` teams. :white_check_mark:
Chandra R.: Follow-up: toggled controller flag `prewarm_strict_mode=true` on staging; reran repro, allocations now time out after 30s despite retries. Will prepare a patch PR to release the flag gate.
Jamie (sre): Once PR lands, let's schedule a short maintenance window to flip on prod guard and run a quick smoke to ensure no customer traffic is affected.
Alice M.: Thanks — looping in account manager @acct-acme for notification. Will post update to the support ticket once credits are applied. :thumbsup:
